content_sections.heading: Bulandshahr Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The District Programme Officer, Bulandshahr has officially released the Bulandshahr Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification dated 24 July 2026 for the recruitment of 678 Anganwadi posts, including 255 Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker) and 423 Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) vacancies. The notification contains complete details regarding district-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limit, educational qualification, reservation, selection process, required documents, and online application procedure. Eligible female candidates are advised to read the complete notification carefully before applying online. The notification is available on the official UP Anganwadi Bharti portal. content_sections.heading: Bulandshahr Anganwadi Karyakatri & Sahayika Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification lists vacancies separately for 16 Child Development Project (Baal Vikas Pariyojna) areas in Bulandshahr district, with reservation category breakup for Unreserved (UR), Other Backward Class (OBC), and Scheduled Caste (SC). The complete project-wise vacancy details are given below. Note: The notification states that the number of vacancies may increase or decrease, and any change will be updated on the official website.: UPSSSC FSL Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 208 Scientific Assistant & Lab Assistant Posts

content_sections.heading: Bulandshahr Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the following conditions before applying for Anganwadi Karyakatri or Sahayika posts in Bulandshahr. Only female candidates are eligible to apply for these posts. Minimum qualification: Intermediate (12th pass) Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained from Intermediate up to postgraduate level; marks obtained in High School (10th) will not be included in the merit calculation. Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 35 years Age will be calculated as on 1 July 2026, based on the date of birth recorded in the High School marksheet/certificate. The candidate must be a resident of the same Gram Sabha (for rural posts) or the same Ward (for urban posts) for which she is applying. Widow candidates: Must submit the husband's death certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer/concerned Municipal Body, along with a certified copy of the family register. Divorced/deserted (Parityakta) candidates: A legal order issued by a competent court is mandatory. Income certificate: Must comply with the income limits fixed for rural and urban areas under applicable UP Government orders, and must be verifiable online. Residence and caste certificates: Only digitally signed certificates that can be verified online will be accepted. Important: If the residence certificate cannot be verified online, the application will not be considered. If the income certificate cannot be verified, the candidate will be treated as above the poverty line. If the caste certificate cannot be verified, the candidate will be treated as belonging to the unreserved category.

content_sections.heading: Bulandshahr Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made purely on the basis of a merit list prepared from academic marks (Intermediate to postgraduate level, and Anganwadi Sahayika merit is based on Intermediate or equivalent up to postgraduate). No written examination or interview will be conducted for these posts. Marks percentage is converted to a merit score by dividing the percentage by 10. For example, 45% marks becomes a score of 4.5, and 59% marks becomes a score of 5.9. Grading/CGPA-based marks will be converted using the same method. Merit will be calculated up to three decimal places; no rounding off will be done beyond the decimal point. If more than one eligible candidate is available in the same category for a post, a full merit list will be prepared among them. The entire selection process will be conducted online through the departmental portal, based on the merit process and priority defined in the governing Government Order.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Bulandshahr Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: High School marksheet/certificate (for date of birth proof) Intermediate and higher educational marksheets/certificates (up to postgraduate, wherever applicable) Digitally signed residence (domicile) certificate, online-verifiable Digitally signed caste certificate (if applicable), online-verifiable Income certificate as per prescribed government norms, online-verifiable Husband's death certificate and family register copy (for widow candidates) Competent court's legal order (for divorced/deserted candidates) Self-attested, clean and legible copies of all documents mentioned in the online application form UPSSSC FSL Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 208 Scientific Assistant & Lab Assistant Posts

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Bulandshahr Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Anganwadi Bharti Portal at https://upanganwadibharti.in/. Find and select the Bulandshahr district recruitment notification for Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika posts. Carefully fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and category details. Upload self-attested, clean, and legible scanned copies of all required certificates as specified in the online form. Verify all entered details (marks, income, caste, and residence certificate numbers, registration numbers, and issue dates) before final submission, since these will be verified online by the portal. Submit the application before 14 August 2026, 12:00 midnight. Applications submitted offline or sent by post will not be accepted under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Bulandshahr Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The complete village/ward-wise vacancy and reservation details, along with eligibility conditions, are displayed at the District Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, District Programme Office, Tehsil, Nagar Palika/Nagar Panchayat Vikas Khand offices, and all Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) offices, apart from the online portal. If any information or document submitted in the application is found to be false, fabricated, or inconsistent with the original records, the application will be rejected. Candidates are strongly cautioned against falling for touts, agents, or middlemen promising selection assistance. The number of vacancies mentioned in this notification is subject to change and will be updated on the official website.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Bulandshahr Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 August 2026, till 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for Bulandshahr Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika posts?
faq.answer: Only female candidates who are residents of the concerned Gram Sabha (rural) or Ward (urban) and meet the educational and age criteria can apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Bulandshahr Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age, calculated as on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th pass).

faq.question: Q5. How many total vacancies are there in Bulandshahr Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 678 total vacancies - 255 for Anganwadi Karyakatri and 423 for Anganwadi Sahayika, spread across 16 projects in Bulandshahr district.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written exam or interview for selection?
faq.answer: No. Selection is made purely through a merit list based on academic marks. No written exam or interview will be conducted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is not mentioned in the official notification. Candidates should check the official portal for updated fee details, if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or honorarium for Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika in Bulandshahr?
faq.answer: These are honorarium-based posts, but the exact honorarium amount is not mentioned in the notification. Candidates can check with the CDPO office or the official portal for current rates.

faq.question: Q9. Can widowed or divorced women apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Widowed candidates must submit their husband's death certificate and family register copy, while divorced or deserted candidates must submit a valid court order.
